messages:
Tess (Product): OK — quick sync. Q1 "sprintization" for Hosted API. We need to slice chat, embeddings, and rerank into shippable increments and lock launch criteria by EOD Friday. Customer asks pushed on latency for embeddings and throughput for rerank.
Marco (Eng): +1. I sketched capacity/effort: 3 sprints for eng core work ( batching + prefix cache + streaming fixes ). We can scope minimal viable in 2 sprints if we drop some non-blocking telemetry work.
Aisha (PM-Customer): For prioritization: 2 strategic customers (FinSearch & NotesAI) need embeddings <100ms p95 for single-embed and rerank throughput 10k QPS for short ctx. Those shapes should shape our acceptance tests.
Ravi (Eng-ML): Important note: to hit 100ms p95 we either need quantized variants + async batch plumbing or aggressive prefix caching. Quantization introduces tiny quality drift — we need an eval set.
Jo (Solutions): For canary, I can onboard FinSearch as early adopter with feature flag and traffic splitter. They want gradual roll (1% -> 25% -> 100%) over 2 weeks. Need clear rollback criteria.
Marco (Eng): Rolling plan sounds fine. Risks: GPU memory under high batching for rerank; we need a spike to validate top-k reranking memory footprint on ampere A10G infra.
Priya (Data): We'll prepare a cross-customer prompt set for quality regression checks (embeddings + rerank), and daily diff dashboards. What metric should trigger regression alerts?
Tess (Product): Keep it simple: embedding cosine drop > 1.5% on core queries OR rerank MRR drop > 2% should block. Also define latency SLO violation: p95 > target for 3 consecutive hours.
Ravi (Eng-ML): I'll own the eval harness. Suggest adding a small headless baseline: run quantized model + float model on sample set and produce quality deltas.
Marco (Eng): Implementation plan proposal (short):
```
Sprint A (2 wks): batching infra + async embeddings API + canary routing
Sprint B (2 wks): KV/prefix cache + streaming stability for chat
Sprint C (2 wks): rerank top-k batching + observability + rollout automation
```
We can compress B+C if we cut telemetry.
Aisha (PM-Customer): For launch criteria, propose: functional tests green, quality deltas within thresholds, performance SLOs met on our test harness, and canary acceptance from at least one paying customer.
Jo (Solutions): Add a doc checklist item: SDK compatibility notes (no breaking changes), sample migration guide, and one-runbook for oncall. I'll draft.
Priya (Data): I'll wire dashboards: per-route p50/p95, token cost estimate, and quality delta trend for the eval set. ETA Tuesday.
Marco (Eng): Dependences: infra team needs new instance types for rerank load tests (request filed). Also need a small config change in routing service to do per-customer model variant pinning.
Tess (Product): Decision points for Friday: 1) commit to 3-sprint plan vs compression 2) pick primary canary customer (FinSearch vs NotesAI) 3) finalize launch metrics.
Aisha (PM-Customer): My recommendation: FinSearch primary (lower risk, already using hosted), NotesAI secondary. FinSearch will sign NDA for early metrics.
Ravi (Eng-ML): We'll run the quantization spike this week. If quality delta > threshold, fallback plan is fast-roll to float model behind a traffic limiter.
Marco (Eng): Who owns rollback automation? I can add a route-level kill switch + automated fallback to previous model if error rate spikes > 5% in 30m.
Jo (Solutions): I'll coordinate the customer comms and sign-off template. Need dev to provide canary logs (token-level cost breakdown) for them.
deploy-bot: Deployment window proposal posted: staging tests Wed 03:00-07:00 UTC, canary rollout Thurs 10:00-14:00 UTC.
Tess (Product): Action items: Marco - finalize sprint plan & spike scope by EOD today. Ravi - eval harness + quantization spike results by Wed. Priya - dashboards by Tue. Jo - canary sign-up + comms draft by Wed. Aisha - secure FinSearch NDA and confirm sample traffic.
Marco (Eng): Noted. I'll post a short RFC with the spike test cases and memory budget.
Tess (Product): Thanks. Quick thumbs: react here with :thumbsup: if you agree to the above scope and timeline. We'll reconvene Fri 9am to lock OKRs.
Aisha (PM-Customer): :thumbsup:
Jo (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:
